minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE MEETING
  SPECIAL MINUTES
  September 26, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, September 26,
2019, at 2:25pm in the Community Room A, 1sth Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.

Chairman Ikemefuna asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Ikemefuna reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  Jen Sandstrom DBA LASED/Turner Hunt to host a Sponsor Launch Event
  at 1000 S. Prairie Avenue, on Thursday, October 10, 2019, from 2:00 p.m.
  – 4:00 p.m. One day event at Hollywood Park; must utilize and provide
  adequate internal security staffing; person directing traffic is required to
  wear highly-visible retro-reflective vests; Inglewood Police Department will
  provide extra patrol as time permits and Watch Commander will be notified;
  Contact Los Angeles Fire Department to obtain applicable tent permit(s);
  Maintain site and ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately after the
  event; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; and
  adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations
  and local, state and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00277116)

  There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:27 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
